scope: UI1 shared foundation assets; no new generated illustrations.

policy.screenshots: Reference and review screenshots are evidence only and must not be shipped as UI assets.
policy.downloadedSvg: Preserve downloaded originals; tint through client rendering.
policy.rasterDerivatives: Android icon PNGs are lossless 4x derivatives of the exact downloaded SVG. Each carries embedded origin metadata.
policy.individualNodeIds: Individual icon node IDs were not retained by the download tool; exact source frame URLs and asset download URLs are recorded.
